name: Brazen Coalition
description: The Brazen Coalition is an alliance of human, ogre and goblin pirates on Ixalan that answers to no one and sails the Stormwreck Sea.

description_citations.text: "Brazen Coalition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

summary.text: The Brazen Coalition is an alliance of human, ogre and goblin pirates on Ixalan that answers to no one and sails the Stormwreck Sea.

citations.text: "Brazen Coalition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

bio.text: It formed from refugees of Torrezon's last conquered city-states, who were spurned by the Sun Empire, scattered across the Stormwreck Sea and turned to raiding Ixalan's coast.

citations.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ixalan (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: It raced to Orazca seeking the Immortal Sun but failed to secure it, and the Sun's removal scattered the Coalition.

citations.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion High and Dry filled with refugees, and Brass and her fleet retook it, with the pirates later uniting with the Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk against the Phyrexians.

citations.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Stormwreck Sea", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Beckett Brass then declared the age of piracy over, made the Coalition a legitimate nation and became its first Governor.

citations.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Afterward its pirates tracked the Mycotyrant into Ixalan's Core.

citations.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: As of the latest stories, the Coalition is a legitimate pirate nation under Governor Brass, whose economy depends on the Downtown mine.

citations.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A month later Huatli and Inti ride to a Brazen Coalition camp on the coast and burn its supplies.
timeline.quote: Sparks flew onto the dry wood of the crates, and almost instantly they caught flame.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk builds up its fort walls just in time for pirates to burn them down.
timeline.quote: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

citation.text: Fiery Cannonade (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spurned by the Sun Empire, the refugee flotilla scatters across the Stormwreck Sea and turns to piracy, raiding Ixalan's coast.
timeline.quote: this refugee flotilla turned to piracy

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition reaches Orazca seeking the Immortal Sun but fails to secure it.
timeline.quote: They reached the Golden City Orazca

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion High and Dry swells with refugees; the fleets leave, then return to find it besieged.
timeline.quote: Hungry and low on supplies, the fleets returned to High and Dry to find it besieged

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and forces a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to support a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
timeline.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first vampire, Elenda of Garrano, ends Torrezon's three-century religious war; the Legion of Dusk conquers the continent and the Brazen Coalition forms.
timeline.quote: their inhabitants took to the sea and formed the Brazen Coalition

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sirens of Ixalan are described as mercurial creatures who serve on Brazen Coalition crews, in at least one case as captain.
timeline.quote: They are mercurial creatures who can turn in an instant from loving to murderous

citation.text: "Siren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The empire, besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, rises to fight off its enemies.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was besieged by pirate raids by the Brazen Coalition and the advance of the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk unite and Zacama fells Etali, saving Ixalan from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion refugees crowd High and Dry; Brass and her fleet retake the city and she becomes de facto leader.
timeline.quote: Brass emerged as the de facto leader of the battered survivors.

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caztaca recounts the coalition's past raids on the Sun Empire's coast.
timeline.quote: They raided our fishing fleets and pillaged our temples

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brazen Coalition explorers find the Oltec unimpressed by cannons.
timeline.quote: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

citation.text: Dauntless Dismantler (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes creates the floating city of High and Dry and leads to the formation of the Brazen Coalition.
timeline.quote: The literal collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes led to the creation of the floating city of High and Dry

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing angry crowds, Brass declares the age of piracy over and the Brazen Coalition a nation.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Elenda meets Huatli, Saheeli, and Caztaca to negotiate an alliance; Beckett Brass interrupts demanding support for the Brazen Coalition.
timeline.quote: The meeting was interrupted by Admiral Beckett Brass

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beckett Brass declares the age of piracy over, makes the Coalition a legitimate nation and becomes its first Governor.
timeline.quote: Beckett Brass declared the age of piracy over

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun's removal shatters Ixalan's planar seal; the Legion retreats, the Coalition scatters and the Sun Empire reclaims Orazca.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire, led by Apatzec Intli III , reclaimed Orazca

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, entrances to the Core are discovered and factions converge on Matzalantli.
timeline.quote: entrances to the plane's Core were discovered across the surface of Ixalan

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brazen Coalition pirates track the Mycotyrant into the Core.
timeline.quote: tracked the Mycotyrant to the Core

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion, Wayta joins the Brazen Coalition for a year, befriends Malcolm Lee, then returns home through faith in the Threefold Sun.
timeline.quote: Wayta joined the Brazen Coalition
